headless.description: Run amfora in headless mode (no UI)

show_sidebar.description: Show sidebar with bookmarks and history

line_width.description: Maximum column width for text wrapping (characters)

show_images.description: Enable display of inline images (requires external viewer)

image_viewer.description: Command used to open linked files (e.g., images)

max_entries.description: Maximum number of history entries to retain

enable_history.description: Enable history logging of visited URLs

bookmarks.description: Initial bookmarks to pre-populate; each entry is a map with 'title' and 'url'. See items for schema.

verify_certificate.description: Verify server TLS certificate against system CA store

strict_tls.description: Require valid TLS certificate (does not affect gemini:// which is unencrypted)
